config.response_transfer: At L3 attention source2/query/both replace perturbed output by recipient zero-delta output plus paired other-context perturbed-minus-baseline response, at fixed local source state. Delta-zero runs restore recipient baseline. none arm is reference. Tests only this early path, not all readers.
config.design: Cross surrounding same/different-key prompt with native same/different-key second-source pre-MLP L2 residual state. Add identical delta*W_h*V at that residual. Compare each perturbation to its own crossed baseline. Freeze item/format/query pairing.
config.prediction: Response follows transplanted local state if local geometry explains conditioning, or surrounding context if later readers/other token states matter; interaction between them is possible.
config.limitations: Hybrid local-state substitutions are diagnostic, not guaranteed on-manifold. State swap changes the entire local residual, not a semantic gate. Other token states/native context unchanged.
